entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A devious, power-hungry and untrustworthy shapeshifting conqueror and planeswalker who quickly betrayed her word once she gained an advantage.

events.summary: Dihada uses her shapeshifting abilities to manipulate those around her, laying the groundwork of her plans years in advance.
events.quote: She used her shapeshifting abilities to manipulate those around her, often laying the groundwork of her plans many years in advance.
